text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey was injured during training, 
so we rushed over to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Something like this... is nothing...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Kh—
choice_data_list:
You're hurting, aren't you? Take the rest 
of the day off.

You're hurting, aren't you? Take the rest 
of the day off.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. I can keep going.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Running on dirt puts less strain on your 
legs. There are plenty of things you can 
do, like focusing on bodily balance over 
time while running at a leisurely pace."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Bodyweight training might be a good 
option too. Either way, coming to a 
complete stop here would be fatal, 
wouldn't it?"
choice_data_list:
...If I think it's impossible, I'll stop 
you immediately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I persuaded her, emphasizing that pushing 
herself now could affect her entire racing 
career, and that I couldn't let her take 
such a risk.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
You won't even allow light training. Is 
that your policy, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't avert my eyes from that cold 
gaze. With an unyielding resolve, I stared 
right back."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...It seems your resolve is firm. 
Understood. I shall rest quietly.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Could you devise our future plans with 
injury rehabilitation as the top priority?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey listened to reason, and 
rested quietly to nurse her injury.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. After all, I understand myself better 
than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, just like this...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
choice_data_list:
Any more is out of the question. Let's 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The risk is too great beyond this point... 
I suppose this is where we pull back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having worsened her injury, Dream Journey 
rested quietly...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"It seems it hasn't affected me that much. 
I'm so sorry for making you worry."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey overcame her injury and made 
a smooth recovery.
